name: tagent-core
description: A persistent TAgent control plane built around the pi coding-agent SDK.

scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/abi packages/core-client packages/governance packages/execution packages/admission && npm run build -w @tagent/memory && tsc -b packages/learning adapters/runtime-pi adapters/persistence-sqlite adapters/http-fastify && npm run build -w @tagent/workspace-local && npm run build -w @tagent/core-service
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && mkdir -p dist/memory/postgres && cp packages/memory/dist/postgres/schema.sql dist/memory/postgres/schema.sql && npm run build -w @tagent/web-console
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm run check -w @tagent/web-console
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && npm run clean -w @tagent/web-console && npm run clean -w @tagent/core-service && npm run clean -w @tagent/http-fastify && npm run clean -w @tagent/workspace-local && npm run clean -w @tagent/persistence-sqlite && npm run clean -w @tagent/learning && npm run clean -w @tagent/memory && npm run clean -w @tagent/runtime-pi && npm run clean -w @tagent/admission && npm run clean -w @tagent/execution && npm run clean -w @tagent/governance && npm run clean -w @tagent/core-client && npm run clean -w @tagent/abi

author: TMs (design), with AI-assisted development
